recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, desaturated portrait of a man in an industrial setting, featuring a strong perspective of overhead pipes and a brick wall, with a hazy light source at the end of the corridor.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned on the right third, looking toward the left negative space
Strong diagonal leading lines from overhead industrial pipes
Contrast between the dark foreground subject and the bright hazy background light
Text block anchored to the left-center, balanced against the subject's mass
coreInvariants: Desaturated color palette with near-monochrome tones
Low-angle perspective emphasizing height and depth

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium-full shot of a male figure occupying the right 40% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright light source at the vanishing point of the corridor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, follow the gaze to the text on the left, then follow the pipes toward the background light.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space on the left side, filled with brick texture and atmospheric haze.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and cool grays (background and clothing)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white (atmospheric light and primary text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan and muted gold (secondary text and graphic dots)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between shadows and highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cool-toned grays and blacks

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the brick wall texture
Aligned with the start of the primary text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight and color contrast within the same typeface family.
graphicDevices: Three horizontal dots (ellipses) in muted gold and cyan preceding the subtitle.

candidateDirections.reason: Similar wide, geometric structure and industrial feel.
Captures the extended, technical aesthetic of the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man in a dark v-neck t-shirt and jeans standing in an industrial hallway. To his left is a dark brick wall. Above him are large industrial pipes receding into a bright, hazy light at the end of the corridor. The image is desaturated, nearly black and white.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of uppercase geometric sans-serif text on the left side. The top line should be white and wide-tracked. The bottom line should be smaller, cyan-colored, and preceded by three small colored dots.

verificationChecks: Is the subject positioned on the right?
Are the overhead pipes creating a strong diagonal perspective?
Is the color palette strictly desaturated?
Is the text clean, geometric, and uppercase?

adjustableVariables: Specific color of the accent text (cyan vs other cool tones)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the pipes lead the eye toward the background light.
Check that the text is legible against the brick texture.
Verify the subject's lighting matches the environment's light sources.
Confirm the desaturated color grading is consistent across the image.
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial setting + receding perspective + desaturated portrait + wide-tracked geometric typography.
